limitations: This is command/wiper directional hysteresis at one small range and unloaded5Vcondition, not uniquely mechanicalgearlash.
Direction also tracks measurement order/time within eachcycle; drift/thermal/supply effects are not independently separated.
Only3cycle pairs at eachPWM; median/IQR/range are descriptive, not a high-confidence physical backlashparameter.
Equivalentinput uses a local linear static fit; potentiometer-to-angle calibration and motor-side motion are absent.
No additional experiment was collected by the analysis agent.
fixture_interpretation: PROVISIONAL: unsecured/free servo case; this is fixture-dependent wiper hysteresis, not fixed-body dynamics or identified gearlash.
